title: Norml SEO Schema
pitch: Generate truthful WordPress structured data with dynamic field maps, PHP handoffs and local validation.
problem: Hardcoded JSON-LD can drift from content, duplicate plugin output or claim facts that do not exist.
A reviewed field map and one output owner keep the graph tied to real data.

flow.d: Identify current output owners and actual query roles.
Select entities and dynamic property sources.
Produce handoff, JSON-LD and conditional PHP.
Check actual output and current feature eligibility.
Inspect live output and optional indexed GSC data.

commands: Wire schema into this WordPress theme

items.name: Type contracts
items.desc: Nine schema files cover eleven core types plus article/local variants.

items.name: PHP mappings
items.desc: Complete reusable core/ACF field maps and conditional integration examples.

items.name: Advisory checks
items.desc: Node validator reads HTML/URL JSON-LD without npm dependencies.

items.role: Per-type fields, mappings and PHP examples.

items: No guaranteed rich result, knowledge panel, ranking or immediate indexing.
ACF examples need ACF or an approved guarded alternative.
Local validation is not full Schema.org/Google policy validation.
GSC inspection reports the indexed version, not a live test.
